section_summary.extract_value: This section reports reliability analyses, sample sizes, and multigroup structural modeling for a single study (N = 238; women n = 160, men n = 78), including a 4-week test–retest subsample of 18 young adult students (M age = 20.65; 94% Caucasian). It describes internal consistency and test–retest reliability for CEMS subscales, gender differences on key measures, and multiple-group path analyses (Mplus) with BMI included as a covariate; the text notes that full correlations and descriptive statistics are presented in Table 1 and that path coefficients are shown in Fig. 2.

section_summary.extract_value: This section reports reliability and validity analyses and the results of Study 1 (N = 238). It includes test–retest reliability for a subsample of 18 students (M age = 20.65, 94% Caucasian), internal consistency alphas for CEMS subscales by gender, gender comparisons (women n = 160; men n = 78) via MANOVA, and a multiple-group structural model with BMI specified as a covariate; Table 1 presents means, SDs, and correlations (women below the diagonal, men above).
